pass2.geometry: camera position + DECLARED camera heading from the same Commons metadata; az-grid D{4,8,16} km x cross{-4,0,+4} km; nested ladder (16km,8),(12km,4),(7.5km,2.5) — spans in EPSG:3857 meters (ground = mercator*cos(lat), the pass-1 convention, declared); county grid for p06; azimuth sweep for p07
